cases.title: feat: 반복 실수 감지(wedge) + addressed 추적

expectedFindings.claim: Repeat matching accepts any JSON array without checking vector length or finite numeric entries, so malformed stored embeddings can produce invalid or misleading similarity results.
Only merged pull requests finalize pending review issues, leaving issues from closed-unmerged pull requests eligible for future repeat detection.

historicalFindings.claim: Stored repeat-candidate embeddings must have the expected dimension and contain only finite numbers before cosine similarity is calculated.
Review issues from a pull request that was closed without merging must not remain eligible as repeat-history candidates.

cases.title: refactor: frontend clean code (22 findings from 4-lens review)

expectedFindings.claim: Malformed JSON in the persisted sidebar state is parsed without a fallback and can crash sidebar initialization.

historicalFindings.claim: Invalid JSON in localStorage must fall back to the default UI state instead of throwing during state initialization.
